package.name: litegrip_cpp
package.description:
C++ SDK for the LiteGrip adaptive two-finger gripper.
This is the bottom layer of the litegrip stack. It speaks SocketCAN and the Damiao DM4310 MIT protocol directly and depends on nothing but the C++17 standard library and the Linux SocketCAN headers — no third-party libraries.
Declared as a plain-cmake package (build_type cmake); the library itself is built and installed like any ordinary CMake project.
